verdict.rationale: The evidence only says that the Apify SDK's SessionPool handles cookies alongside proxy rotation (apify-docs-31), and that Actors such as web-scraper accept configurable input via the API (apify-docs-15). This implies a developer could build an Actor that uses session cookies, but nothing shows a documented way to pass your own session cookies through the API to fetch authenticated pages. Missing for 10: an explicit input or API parameter for user-supplied cookies, docs on fetching authenticated pages, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
